title: See what dispatch heard
changes: Say "Dispatch, radio check" and the AI dispatcher answers loud and clear, so you can test that it hears you. It used to stay silent on a radio check

RPM CyberCom in /setup and View Settings in /config dispatch now show what the dispatcher last heard on the radio, and why it did not answer if it did not: no dispatch channel, no officer role, no audio coming through, or a line that did not start with "dispatch"
